content: Here we focus on two such tasks: grammatical error correction (GEC) and style transfer. Modern approaches to GEC learn from parallel corpora of erroneous segments and their manual corrections BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 ; text style transfer also relies on supervised approaches that require texts of the same meaning and different styles BIBREF7 , BIBREF8 or imprecise unsupervised methods BIBREF9 , BIBREF10 .
